source.gives: Black's mid-18th-century balance is the original analytical balance; Fortin built Lavoisier's balance (Whipple: finished 1788, sensitivity about 1/100 grain, 0.6 mg; Encyclopedia.com: arm one metre long, 1/400 ounce; the figures are not obviously compatible); Ramsden hydrostatic balance 1785-89, Royal Society 1789, under 0.01 grain; a French source dates Fortin's tresbuchet 1792
